blocks.title: »pomBasic«
blocks.text:
Process-oriented compact solutions
for tool inspection

Inquire now

blocks.body:
Do you want to speed up your work processes? Then take the shortcut for tool measurement and inspection. The ZOLLER »pomBasic« series is the ideal solution for well-thought-out, economically structured preparation and production of precision tools.

Save yourself unnecessary trips to the measuring room and benefit from efficient processes and precise results in record time. With their compact dimensions, the ZOLLER »pomBasic« inspection machines can be positioned anywhere in your production – directly next to the CNC grinding machine, in the goods receipt area or at the tool issue.

Request now 1:1 expert meeting

Calibrating measuring devices on site with certified test specimens and reference standards is an important part of quality assurance at E. ZOLLER GmbH & Co. KG - this is how we guarantee reliable measurement results and the high precision of your products in accordance with applicable standards.

spots.label: Software »pomSoft 2«
spots.text:
Software »pomSoft 2«

Software »pomSoft 2«

Software »pomSoft 2« – is self-explanatory, clearly laid out and enables the operator to take reliable measurements. The 32" TFT color monitor impresses with its industry standard and its integration directly on the device.

spots.label: Reflected-light camera
spots.text:
Reflected-light camera

Reflected-light camera

Reflected-light camera – whose axis can be manually fine-tuned or, depending on the application, is also available with CNC control. Depending on the model, a color camera with a zoom lens, a monochrome camera with a fixed aperture, or a monochrome camera with a zoom lens is available for micro-tool inspection.

spots.label: Additional illumination
spots.text:
Additional illumination

Additional illumination

Additional illumination – enables transmitted light measurement in the circumferential area and allows external contours, step lengths, point angles and much more to be measured.

spots.label: Board for mouse and keyboard
spots.text:
Board for mouse and keyboard

Board for mouse and keyboard

Board for mouse and keyboard – is a space-saving pull-out drawer that is ergonomically located on the lower table.

spots.label: Color laser printer
spots.text:
Color laser printer

Color laser printer

Color laser printer – for report and list printing has its place in the practical machine table.

spots.label: Drawing holder
spots.text:
Drawing holder

Drawing holder

Drawing holder – is ideal for attaching drawings in direct proximity of the measurement. The magnetic spherical joint allows flexible and optimal alignment for the operator. The drawings can be easily fixed and quickly changed using magnets.

spots.label: Manual fine adjustment
spots.text:
Manual fine adjustment

Manual fine adjustment of the X and Y axes

Manual fine adjustment of the X and Y axes – is precise and backlash-free, making it ideal for process-oriented tool measurement.

spots.label: »pomLightTube«
spots.text:
»pomLightTube«

Additional illumination »pomLightTube«

Additional illumination »pomLightTube« – the LED illumination tunnel ensures highcontrast lighting of the tool cutting edge in incident light. In addition, spot lighting can be attached as an option to perfectly illuminate concealed tool geometries.

spots.label: Document and accessory board
spots.text:
Document and accessory board

Document and accessory board

Document and accessory board – in the machine table provides sufficient storage space and convenient access to your documents and accessories.

columns.header: Automatic Inspection with the Macro Function
columns.body:
If you have repetitive measuring tasks and want to carry them out effectively, ZOLLER has the perfect solution: thanks to the macro function, repeat measurements can be saved easily and reliably.

A single click on your saved macro program is all it takes and the measuring process runs automatically: simple, fast and user-friendly.

slides.text: Display of your currently loaded macro program for quick program start
1. program start with display of the reference picture
2. positioning the tool to be measured in relation to the reference image
3. automatic measurement of the defined parameters
4. overview of all determined measurement results with tolerances

blocks.header: Measuring Saw Blades Tooth by Tooth
blocks.body:
The saw blade holder extends the range of applications for »pomBasic«. It can be used to clamp saw blades with a diameter of 150 mm to 600 mm with corresponding reduction rings.

Image processing »pomSoft 2« ZOLLER swivel table

blocks.title: »pomSoft 2«
blocks.text: With »pomSoft 2« image processing, a large number of parameters and geometries on the teeth of the saw blades can be determined axially and radially in incident light.

blocks.body:
A ZOLLER »pomBasic« is simple, fast, and safe to use – three unbeatable strengths that couldn’t be more accurate. But its design also provides the foundation for measurements exact to the micrometer: The arrangement of the linear axes and the integrated cable routing, with the resulting ergonomics and durability, are unique in the market.

The ZOLLER Inspection & Measuring solution proves what many claim: quality.

More about Inspection & Measuring

Wizard-guided measuring sequences, seamless inspection reports at the touch of a button and the tool-specific management of all parameters in the z.One central ZOLLER tool database ensure efficient production processes and traceable quality at all times.
